document_title: Stage 4.2.8 — PILOT-GATE-01 Revision 2: Pre-Execution Gate, Strict Manifest Validation, OS-Level Owned Process Verification, Consistent Snapshot Integrity & Config Mutation Intercept Report

P0-B_os_level_owned_process_verification.mechanism: psutil OS-level inspection of target_pid, proc.exe(), proc.create_time(), and listener port 8089
P0-B_os_level_owned_process_verification.venv_launcher_resolution: Checks pyvenv.cfg for underlying Python interpreter binary match
P0-B_os_level_owned_process_verification.foreign_process_protection: Unconditional refusal to terminate foreign or unverified PIDs (0 kill signals)

P0-C_snapshot_integrity_verification.sqlite_validation: PRAGMA quick_check == 'ok' and non-empty sqlite_master tables check with resource cleanup
P0-C_snapshot_integrity_verification.lancedb_validation: Non-empty index_manifest.json with required metadata and documents_1024.lance table directory

P0-D_config_mutation_intercept.mechanism: Config fingerprint and storage scope verified immediately before Step A (OFF) AND immediately before Step B (ON)
P0-D_config_mutation_intercept.tamper_prevention: If config or scope is mutated during Step A, Step B (ON) is strictly NOT called (0 ON calls)
P0-D_config_mutation_intercept.termination_verdict: Loop halts immediately with CONFIG_TAMPER_DETECTED and verdict BLOCKED

G2-01.name: test_contract_g2_01_manifest_missing_schema_or_hash_fails_closed
G2-01.description: 105 positions manifest missing top-level schema or manifest_sha256 fails closed before worker spawn with 0 calls
G2-01.expected: MANIFEST_SCHEMA_INVALID or MANIFEST_HASH_MISSING_OR_INVALID, runner returns CONFIG_INVALID, actual_search_calls == 0
G2-01.observed: MANIFEST_SCHEMA_INVALID and MANIFEST_HASH_MISSING_OR_INVALID caught, runner verdict BLOCKED, status CONFIG_INVALID, 0 calls

G2-02.name: test_contract_g2_02_manifest_arbitrary_category_or_bad_types_fails_closed
G2-02.description: Arbitrary category, mismatched header counters, or query_text with dict/int type fails closed
G2-02.observed: All 3 invalid inputs rejected; MANIFEST_INVALID_CATEGORY, MANIFEST_NORMATIVE_COUNT_MISMATCH, MANIFEST_INVALID_QUERY_TEXT verified

G2-03.name: test_contract_g2_03_malicious_or_empty_id_position_gap_fails_closed_repetition_allowed
G2-03.description: Malicious/empty ID, position gap, invalid hash fails closed; legitimate duplicate query_text with distinct query_id succeeds
G2-03.expected: MANIFEST_MALICIOUS_OR_EMPTY_ID, MANIFEST_POSITION_GAP rejected; duplicate query_text permitted and loaded
G2-03.observed: Rejections confirmed; duplicate query_text successfully loaded with valid schema and distinct IDs

G2-04.name: test_contract_g2_04_max_queries_zero_or_negative_fails_closed_zero_calls
G2-04.description: max_queries=0 or negative value yields explicit failure or 0 calls, never running all queries
G2-04.expected: verdict BLOCKED, status CONFIG_INVALID, total_queries_planned=0, actual_search_calls_executed=0
G2-04.observed: max_queries=0 and max_queries=-10 both return BLOCKED, CONFIG_INVALID, total_queries_planned=0, 0 calls executed

G2-05.name: test_contract_g2_05_target_pid_foreign_exe_or_mismatched_start_time_rejected
G2-05.description: Real PID with foreign executable path or mismatched create_time strictly rejected
G2-05.expected: verify_process_termination_safety returns PROCESS_PATH_MISMATCH and PROCESS_START_TIME_MISMATCH, safe=False
G2-05.observed: Foreign exe yields PROCESS_PATH_MISMATCH; mismatched start time yields PROCESS_START_TIME_MISMATCH; 0 termination signals

G2-06.name: test_contract_g2_06_pid_reuse_vanished_pid_or_foreign_listener_rejected_own_metadata_verified
G2-06.description: PID reuse, vanished PID, foreign listener unconditionally rejected; own process verified
G2-06.expected: Vanished PID yields PROCESS_NOT_FOUND; foreign port listener yields PORT_8089_IN_USE_BY_FOREIGN_PROCESS; own process verified
G2-06.observed: Vanished PID rejected; foreign listener rejected; own process identity verified with psutil

G2-07.name: test_contract_g2_07_garbage_sqlite_or_empty_manifest_yields_snapshot_no_go
G2-07.description: Garbage bytes in SQLite, empty manifest, or missing lance table strictly yields SNAPSHOT_NO_GO
G2-07.observed: Garbage SQLite fails with SNAPSHOT_SQLITE_INVALID; empty manifest fails with SNAPSHOT_LANCEDB_EMPTY_MANIFEST; missing table fails

G2-08.name: test_contract_g2_08_wal_zero_sample_match_without_consistency_proof_unverified
G2-08.description: WAL=0, sample match, but missing consistency proof yields UNVERIFIED, not CONSISTENT_SNAPSHOT_VERIFIED
G2-08.expected: SNAPSHOT_CONSISTENCY_PROOF_REQUIRED returned when require_consistency_proof=True, state remains UNVERIFIED
G2-08.observed: SNAPSHOT_CONSISTENCY_PROOF_REQUIRED returned, verified status not granted without proof

G2-09.name: test_contract_g2_09_yaml_tampered_during_off_strictly_zeros_on_and_yields_blocked
G2-09.description: OFF search mutates YAML to production path -> ON spy call count is strictly 0, verdict BLOCKED
G2-09.expected: Pre-ON guard intercepts mutation, ON search spy call count is strictly 0, status CONFIG_TAMPER_DETECTED, verdict BLOCKED
G2-09.observed: Step B (ON) call count == 0; total calls == 1 (OFF only); status == CONFIG_TAMPER_DETECTED; verdict == BLOCKED

G2-10.name: test_contract_g2_10_config_or_symlink_drift_before_worker_halts_with_zero_new_workers
G2-10.description: Config modification or symlink before worker call halts with 0 new workers and no false GO
G2-10.expected: verdict BLOCKED, status in (CONFIG_INVALID, CONFIG_TAMPER_DETECTED), actual_search_calls_executed == 0
G2-10.observed: verdict == BLOCKED, status == CONFIG_INVALID, actual_search_calls_executed == 0, search spy call_count == 0
